name: Four Revolve For Relief
source:
It's a story of 4 days of struggle where Okiomi tries to prevent the car accident that kills Akemi. Use a mysterious notebook to save her in this adventure game (with fairly high difficulty).

Rules of the notebook:
1. You cannot erase what you write on it
2. One person can use 4 pages maximum.
3. No one except the person who wrote it can read what is written on it.
4. The notebook will vanish when you looped ten times or next time you use it after using up all the 4 pages.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ143404.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于4天的奋斗故事，Okiomi试图阻止导致Akemi死亡的车祸。在这个冒险游戏（难度相当高）中使用神秘笔记本来拯救她。

笔记本规则：
1. 写在上面的内容无法擦除2. 一人最多可使用4页。
3. 除书写者外，任何人都无法阅读其上所写的内容。
4. 当你循环十次或用完全部4页后下次使用笔记本时，笔记本将消失。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ143404.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
